- Procurement provides PO or redline feedback by Tue 6/9.
- Exec-level signoff (one signer from StellarSys legal + one from your exec sponsor) between 6/10–6/12.
- DocuSign packet created and routed 6/13; proposed start date: 2026-06-22.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf, EvaluationPlan_STELLARSYS.xlsx, SOW_v1.2.docx

If the signature window slips, we will push start to 7/6. Can you confirm which of your internal approvers will be on the DocuSign route? Also flag any procurement hold points we should be aware of.

Thanks,
